footer.tagline: Kermanshah Heritage, smart QR-based cultural tourism

home.title: Every stone has a story. Just scan.
home.description: Scan the QR code beside historical sites across Kermanshah, from Taq-e Bostan to Bisotun, and read each place's history, images, and narrative on the spot.

steps.body: No app install needed. The page opens directly in your browser.
